system.description: Spending three Blood Traits grants monumental strength for the rest of the scene: unarmed strikes inflict three additional levels of lethal damage, and improvised heavy weapons (telephone poles, chunks of concrete, cars) grant six bonus Traits to bid and two additional levels of lethal damage. Enables feats like punching through hulls or ripping cars apart, subject to Static Physical Challenges at Storyteller discretion. Any solid hit against a mortal or ghoul kills them instantly unless the blow is deliberately pulled.
